description: This file contains code for a translation verification system that uses Google Generative AI to analyze translation quality, correctness, and politeness. It defines a class 'TranslationVerifier' with methods to perform the verification process, including prompt setup and API invocation.

classes.name: TranslationVerifier
classes.description: A class that encapsulates the logic for verifying translation quality using an AI model, including initialization with API key and a method to perform verification.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the TranslationVerifier with an API key, setting up the AI model for subsequent verification calls.

methods.name: verify
methods.description: Asynchronously sends a translation diff to the AI model for analysis and returns the generated verification report.
